decisions.reason: As the flagship digital anamnesis line close to the core software and in step with digitalization trends, it remains a valuable, low-cost option to keep.
The education institute leverages existing training content and the customer base at little cost, and its value as a customer-retention option still justifies keeping it open.
The analytics dashboard is an extension of the core software that costs little to maintain and fits the firm's direction toward efficiently managed practices, so keeping the option open is sensible.
The complete practice bundle mainly repackages core offerings, so it is cheap to keep and supports sales to new practices.
The listing portal is distant from the core and its value is still unclear, but its upkeep is likely modest and the dental staff shortage keeps some upside, so it stays for now under closer scrutiny.
